verdict.rationale: n8n can be self-hosted via Docker and controlled via CLI (n8n-docs-17), triggered via webhooks/API (n8n-docs-21, n8n-docs-16) and has error-workflow handling (n8n-docs-5), all of which support headless/automated execution outside the UI. However there is no explicit CI-specific documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions recipes, exit-code semantics for pipelines) or independent evidence of it being run in CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, hands-on community confirmation of headless CI usage, documented exit-code/status reporting for automated pipelines.
